These are the first 100 unmodified examples and labels from the MNIST **test**
split, stored as a compressed NumPy archive for deterministic offline OCR checks.
They are not training examples and were not selected by prediction correctness.

Source files (public MNIST mirror maintained by CVDF):
- https://storage.googleapis.com/cvdf-datasets/mnist/t10k-images-idx3-ubyte.gz
- https://storage.googleapis.com/cvdf-datasets/mnist/t10k-labels-idx1-ubyte.gz

Original MNIST authors: Yann LeCun, Corinna Cortes and Christopher J. C. Burges.
http://yann.lecun.com/exdb/mnist/

These small tests exercise normalization, rejection and printed-sheet reading.
They do not establish accuracy on arbitrary classroom handwriting or photographs.
